description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Chameleon.
Activate Chameleon by tapping it.
When Chameleon becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Chameleon's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
